3.2.title: V3.2 Update
features: **Grab Fling** - hold a keybind to fling any player gripping you; Auto Grab mode picks the closest player automatically.
**Grab Force** - hold a keybind to force-grab up to two gripping players; release to drop them.
**Grab Pull** (Reel In) - reel gripping players toward you on hold.
**Grab Tornado** - make gripping players orbit wildly around you on hold.
Wrist menu now shows the active keybind in each module title.
Wrist menu: inline search view with on-screen VR keyboard, replacing the old separate search panel.
Deck UI overhauled: emerald color theme, keyboard navigation, improved search + category filters, refreshed home-dashboard layout.
Deck UI is now resizable to a smaller minimum size; header and inspector panel adapt responsively and hide when the panel is too small.
Module list on PC uses normal-weight text with a drop shadow and tighter padding for a crisper look.
Gun-type modules (Fling Gun, Tag Gun, Copy Gun, Critters Spam Gun, Hoverboard Gun) now delegate cooldown tracking to the pointer system, removing duplicate cooldown logic.
Fixed: - Fixed wrist menu sounds and haptics not playing.
Fixed: - Fixed wrist menu keybind capture: held inputs are suppressed at rebind start and the capture clears on timeout instead of keeping a stale bind.
Fixed: - Fixed wrist menu settings view randomly re-ordering module buttons after a setting change.
Fixed: - Fixed wrist menu not opening after switching between PC and VR mode.
Fixed: - Fixed Deck UI VR interaction bugs and a stuck input gate that blocked re-opening the panel.
Fixed: - Removed auto-focus of the search bar when the Deck UI opens.
Fixed: - `Low Quality Mic` now properly applies and restores the recorder's sampling rate and bitrate.
3.2.notes: Coming soon: Barrel cosmetic OP modules (Barrel Fling, Barrel Launch, Barrel Bring, Barrel Kick, Barrel Crash) - work in progress.

3.3.title: V3.3 Update
features: Room Controls Unlock - unlocks room control modules.
Silence Gun [M] - mutes the player you point at.
Unsilence Gun [M] - unmutes the player you point at.
Kick Gun [M] - kicks the player you point at.
Block Gun [M] - blocks the player you point at from rejoining.
Launch Gun - launches the player you point at.
Launch All - launches every player in the room.
Dig Gun - carves or builds terrain where you point.
Scavenger Complete - completes scavenger hunts for you.
Full Body Tracking - unlocks full-body tracking.
Forwards Body - pitches your body forward.
Backwards Body - makes your body face backwards.
Crawling Body - makes your body crawl on the ground.
Upside Down Body - flips your body upside down.
Spaz Body - jitters your body and head.
Full Spin Bot - spins your whole rig.
Upside Down Spin Bot - spins your rig while upside down.
Force Tag Effect Gun - forces tag effects onto players.
Tappable Spam - spams tappable objects around the map.
Cosmetic Flood - floods other players with cosmetic updates.
Flag Recolor - recolors all plantable flags in the room.
Flag Crash Gun - crashes the player you point at on flag maps.
Flag Crash All - crashes everyone else on flag maps.
Paint Splat Gun - shoots paint splats where you point.
Surface Earrape - spams loud surface-hit sounds for other players.
Rope Spaz - makes ropes thrash around.
Rope Yeet - launches ropes in the selected direction.
Rope Crash - crashes players on maps with legacy ropes.
Fixed: Fixed default VR keybinds not working.
Fixed: Fixed Deck UI default width so the inspector shows.
Fixed: Fixed sound-spam modules using bad sound indices and unclear volume settings.
Fixed: Fixed module export generation.
Fixed: Reset settings for v3.3 defaults.
Fixed: Improved Dig Gun bounds and cooldowns.
Fixed: Improved room control bypass behavior.
Fixed: Improved module categories and Deck/Wrist UI ordering.
Fixed: Improved performance with runtime caching.
removedModules: Removed Snowball Effect Gun; it has been replaced by Force Tag Effect Gun.

3.4.title: V3.4 Update
features: Report Hider - re-slots you in the lobby so your report buttons are harder to reach on other players' scoreboards.
Customizable PC Deck UI layout - make the menu your own:
Create your own custom categories.
Rename, hide, and reorder the category tabs.
Drag to reorder modules inside any category.
Add modules to one or more custom categories.
Reset to the default layout at any time.
Your layout is saved in settings and restored on relaunch.
Fixed: Refreshed the Deck UI look: cleaner graphite/blue dark theme, rounded corners on category bars, enabled modules, and sliders.
Fixed: Improved module card selected/enabled states and description readability.
Fixed: Improved slider rounding, fill rendering, and accent colors.
Fixed: Fixed category drag-and-drop order resetting after UI rebuilds.
Fixed: Fixed selected category drag reorder snapping back.
Fixed: Fixed category renames only updating after switching tabs.
Fixed: Added visible typing/focus feedback for category rename inputs.
Fixed: Improved projectile launch planning and RPC throttling; cleaner separation of local display vs. remote sends.
Fixed: Improved Report Hider / Rejoin reliability by preserving the exact room code and retrying joins after leaving.
Fixed: Added room-full and join-failure notifications to the Room tab, Rejoin, and Report Hider flows.
Fixed: Report Hider now only notifies you when it actually acts.
Fixed: Improved DevUpdater release-note handling from `CHANGELOG.md`.
